title: PUFFER: Incremental Fuzzy Deduplication for Continuously Evolving Corpora
abstract: arXiv:2608.28622v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Large language model training corpora grow through successive, often redundant releases, so each release must be deduplicated against both itself and the accumulated history. At trillion-token scale, this requires incremental ingestion, bounded resident memory, deterministic retry, and dataset-scoped lifecycle control without repeated corpus-wide rebuilding. We introduce PUFFER (Provenance-aware Updatable Fuzzy Filtering for Evolving Repositories), a MinHash-LSH fuzzy-deduplication pipeline built around two design choices. First, PUFFER stores each LSH band as immutable, dataset-tagged, memory-mapped sorted segments, enabling exact historical band-key membership checks without RAM proportional to corpus size. Second, T-fanout tiered compaction periodically merges segments to control screening fanout, trading lower query cost against additional index-maintenance writes while preserving membership decisions. translated_title: PUFFER：面向持续演化语料库的增量式模糊去重
translated_abstract: 大语言模型训练语料库通过连续且常常冗余的发布不断增长，因此每次发布都必须针对其自身以及累积的历史数据进行去重。在万亿词元规模下，这要求系统支持增量式数据摄取、有界的常驻内存、确定性的重试机制以及数据集级别的生命周期控制，而无需反复进行全语料库重建。我们提出了 PUFFER（面向演化仓库的溯源感知可更新模糊过滤），这是一个围绕两项核心设计构建的 MinHash-LSH 模糊去重流水线。首先，PUFFER 将每个 LSH 桶存储为不可变的、带有数据集标签的、内存映射的有序分段，从而能够在不占用与语料库规模成正比的内存的情况下，实现对历史桶键的精确成员检查。其次，T-扇出分层压实机制会周期性地合并分段以控制筛选扇出，在保持成员判定结果不变的前提下，以额外的索引维护写入开销换取更低的查询成本。在摄取的 N 个键和 K
tldr: PUFFER 提出了一种面向持续增长的大模型训练语料的增量式 MinHash-LSH 模糊去重流水线，通过不可变、带数据集标签的内存映射有序分段存储与 T-扇出分层压实两项设计，在万亿词元规模下实现了有界内存占用、精确的历史成员检查与确定性重试，而无需反复全语料库重建。
en_tdlr: PUFFER is an incremental MinHash-LSH fuzzy deduplication pipeline for continuously evolving LLM training corpora that, through immutable dataset-tagged memory-mapped sorted segment storage and T-fanout tiered compaction, achieves bounded resident memory, exact historical band-key membership checks, and deterministic retries at trillion-token scale without repeated corpus-wide rebuilding.
